title: The Flintstones - Volcanic 2
description:
Ripped from the second level of Volcanic in The Flintstones on Super NES.

Notes:

- Recommended H-Scroll: Constant and V-Scroll: Constant.
- That must be used ONLY for Vertical levels but if want use it for Horizontal levels, you must use Slow Horizontal Layer 2 (BG) Scrolling Rate patch.
